document.name: QBK Sports Youth Beach Volleyball
document.shortDescription: Indoor beach volleyball classes in Sunnyside for kids ages 6+ with weekday after-school sessions plus Saturday and Sunday training.
document.longDescription:
QBK Sports publishes youth beach volleyball classes at its Sunnyside facility for children in grades 4 and up. The official page breaks the program into Cubs Club for ages 6-9 and Seals classes for ages 10-12 and 13+, describing the program as an all-abilities pathway into beach volleyball skills, teamwork, and sportsmanship.

The same page gives a detailed recurring schedule. Cubs are listed on Tuesdays 5:00-6:00 PM, Thursdays 3:30-4:30 PM, and Saturdays 9:00-10:00 AM. Seals ages 10-12 are listed on Mondays or Thursdays 4:30-6:00 PM, Tuesdays 3:30-5:00 PM, Saturdays 9:00-10:30 AM and 10:30 AM-12:00 PM, and Sundays 11:00 AM-12:30 PM. Seals ages 13+ are listed on Mondays or Wednesdays 4:30-6:00 PM and Saturdays 9:00-10:30 AM and 10:30 AM-12:00 PM.

QBK's official page says the facility is located at 41-20 39th St in Sunnyside, Queens and directs families to register for a free trial by emailing youth@qbksports.com. The provider image here is an ImgBB re-host of QBK's official youth volleyball hero image from the same page.

Sources: https://www.qbksports.com/youth-beach-volleyball-classes https://static.wixstatic.com/media/541d0d_3e7129e89b484d34a689f79dbc4bc742~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_2500,h_1662,al_c/541d0d_3e7129e89b484d34a689f79dbc4bc742~mv2.jpg
